title: Create a first project
objective: Show a new customer how to create and name a project.

steps.title: Open the dashboard
steps.narration: Begin on the dashboard, where all of your projects live.

steps.title: Create a project
steps.narration: Choose Create project to get started.

steps.title: Name the project
steps.narration: Give the project a recognizable name.

steps.title: Confirm creation
steps.narration: Then create it. Your workspace is ready immediately.
steps.expected: The new project workspace is visible.
